name: Unitree B1
summary: An industrial quadruped of about 50 kg that Unitree still lists next to the newer B2, with a waterproof body, 20 kg recommended walking load and about 2 h walking endurance without load.

germany.statusNote: RBTX (igus marketplace) lists the Unitree B1 at 63,530 € plus VAT and shipping with an add-to-cart button and a usual delivery time of 3 weeks.

sellers.name: RBTX marketplace (igus SE & Co. KG)
sellers.note: Article RBTX-UNIT-0003. Scope of delivery: robot, one battery, charger and remote controller.

notes: IP class differs between sources: Unitree's page headline says IP68, the RBTX table says IP67.
Unitree lists security patrols, surveys and exploration, and public rescue as application directions; no autonomy software package is named.
The RBTX spec table prints the speed as "2.000 m/s", which is clearly a typo; its text says 1.8 m/s.
